sloka: तस्याः सा दीर्घविपुला वेपन्त्या सीतया तदा ।ददृशे कम्पिनी वेणी व्यालीव परिसर्पती ।। ५.२५.९।।।।
transliteration: tasyāḥ sā dīrghavipulā vepantyā sītayā tadā ।dadṛśe kampinī veṇī vyālīva parisarpatī ।। 5.25.9।।।।

translations.english: The long, luxuriant braid of hair of the trembling Sita waving (in the wind), appeared like a crawling female serpent.
